Request next steps Graduation day WHY DENTAL ASSISTING? A career that opens doors A fast, hands-on way into healthcare — with steady demand, flexible hours, and room to grow. 15.3% Employment Outlook Dental Assistants jobs are expected to increase by 15.3% between 2018 and 2028. $18–22 Median Wage Starting pay is between $18 - $22 depending on your state and employer. PT · FT Flexible Schedules Dental assisting gives you an opportunity to have a work/life balance. Full time, part time, and temping positions allows for a flexible work schedule. Not to mention most offices have evenings, weekends, and holidays off. DA → RDA Multiple Career Paths Being a Dental Assistant is the stepping stone into the dental field. You will explore a variety of career options the dental field has to offer. As a dental assistant you will have the knowledge to make an easy transition to another role in dentistry.
